(a) Since $-2<1$, use the first rule.
$\begin{aligned}f(-2)&=\dfrac{15}{-2+5}\\&=\dfrac{15}{3}\\&=5\end{aligned}$

(b) The condition $x\ge1$ includes the boundary $x=1$.
$\begin{aligned}f(1)&=2(1)+3\\&=5\end{aligned}$

(a) Since $1<3$, use $2^{x}$.
$h(1)=2^{1}=2$

(b) Since $3\le3\le5$, use the constant rule.
$h(3)=6$

(c) Since $7>5$, use $(x-3)^{2}$.
$\begin{aligned}h(7)&=(7-3)^{2}\\&=4^{2}\\&=16\end{aligned}$

(a) At $x=1$, the filled circle at $(1,4)$ is included. The open circle at $(1,1)$ is excluded.
$g(1)=4$

(b) At $x=-1$, the graph passes through $(-1,3)$, so $g(-1)=3$.
$\begin{aligned}g(-1)+g(1)&=3+4\\&=7\end{aligned}$

(a) Since $1.5>0$, use $x^{2}-1$.
$\begin{aligned}p(1.5)&=(1.5)^{2}-1\\&=2.25-1\\&=1.25\end{aligned}$
Since $-0.5\le0$, use $5-2x$.
$\begin{aligned}p(-0.5)&=5-2(-0.5)\\&=6\end{aligned}$
Subtract the function values.
$\begin{aligned}p(1.5)-p(-0.5)&=1.25-6\\&=-4.75\end{aligned}$

(b) The condition $x\le0$ includes $x=0$, while $2>0$ uses the second rule.
$\begin{aligned}p(0)&=5-2(0)\\&=5\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}p(2)&=2^{2}-1\\&=3\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}2p(0)+p(2)&=2(5)+3\\&=13\end{aligned}$

examples.derivation: At -2, the permitted first branch gives 15/(-2+5)=15/3=5. At 1, the inclusive second branch gives 2(1)+3=5. Rational branches are supported by Foundation 2(a); branch selection follows Development 6.

The inputs 1, 3 and 7 belong respectively to the first, middle and last intervals. Thus h(1)=2, h(3)=6 and h(7)=(7-3)^2=16. Multiple intervals and constant rules follow Development 5; exponential branches appear in the supplied worked example.

The descending segment has rule y=2-x, giving g(-1)=3. Its endpoint (1,1) is open; the horizontal branch includes (1,4), so g(1)=4 and g(-1)+g(1)=7. The plotted coordinates, markers and arrows agree. Reading included endpoints and combining graph values follow Development 4 and the later Development 3(a).

The positive branch gives p(1.5)=2.25-1=1.25 and p(2)=4-1=3. The non-positive branch gives p(-0.5)=5+1=6 and p(0)=5. Therefore the difference is -4.75 and 2p(0)+p(2)=13. Separate branch evaluations followed by subtraction or multiplication/addition follow Development 6.
